correctness.rationale: Moving the leftmost 1 repeatedly deletes the first min(k, total ones) original 1s and appends them. For m<=n-k, if the first m+k original symbols have at least k ones, deleting the first k leaves precisely m prefix symbols; otherwise at least m zeros remain there. This gives the positive-part formula for Q_m. The appended suffix, or the entirely sorted word when fewer than k ones exist, gives the second case. For irrational mechanical factors each prefix count has a unique phase cut c_j. Q_n always jumps at c_n, and a cut c_j with j<n survives exactly when j*alpha>k. No image can recur after a jump because all output prefix counts are nondecreasing in phase. Thus the image count is 2+max(0,n-1-floor(k/alpha)), including k>n where both weight classes are sorted, and the last length of agreement with Abelian complexity is floor(k/alpha)+1.
residual_risks: The recorded finite-slope regressions use decimal approximations. Correctness rests on the exact phase argument, not those regressions.
